title: Enhancing the corrosion resistance of waterborne epoxy coatings with functionalized biochar

This study uses discarded tree leaves to produce biomass porous carbon nanosheets (PCNS) via carbonization and pore-forming processes, then modifies them with carboxymethyl chitosan (CMCS) and 8-hydroxyquinoline (8-HQ).
